_comment: PRE-DEPLOY TEMPLATE ONLY: do not use as a production trust root while any
0xFILL... placeholder remains. Preflight/verify must fail closed on placeholders.
Authoritative per-chain deploy manifest for the v1.0.0 Lockdown singleton.
The v1.0.0 launch target is Ethereum mainnet only. This template is NOT an
active trust root until Ethereum has canonical Safe v1.5.0 + Transaction
Service support and passes every per-chain gate below.
Since the preflight/verify scripts bind EXTCODEHASH secure-by-default,
the codehashes below are the trust root: a same-address fake is rejected
only if the operator checks against the CORRECT hash. Maintain this file
in version control and review changes like code.
How the codehashes behave across chains:
- bundled verifier runtimes: chain-INVARIANT (all are constructor-free).
The WebAuthn UV policy is a compile-time constant, so each policy is a
SEPARATE contract: WebAuthnVerifier (UV required) and
WebAuthnVerifierNoUV (UP only). Pin the hash of the one you deploy;
RequireUVTrue is WebAuthnVerifier, RequireUVFalse is WebAuthnVerifierNoUV.
Regenerate after any source/compiler change with scripts/gen-manifest-codehashes.sh.
- multiSendCallOnly: per-chain. Use the canonical Safe v1.5.0
MultiSendCallOnly for that chain (address AND its on-chain EXTCODEHASH).
- singleton (Lockdown): per-chain, POST-DEPLOY only. It bakes the
MULTI_SEND_CALL_ONLY immutable into its runtime, so its codehash differs
whenever that immutable differs. Read it from chain after deploy:
cast keccak "$(cast code <singleton> --rpc-url <rpc>)"
Usage:
scripts/preflight-install-v1.sh --safe S --singleton X --rpc R --manifest deploy/manifest.json
scripts/verify-install-v1.sh    --safe S --singleton X --rpc R --manifest deploy/manifest.json
The scripts read .chains[<chainId>].singletonCodehash, .multiSendCodehash,
.fallbackHandlerAddress, .fallbackHandlerCodehash, and
.safeMasterCopyCodehash (the canonical Safe v1.5.0 singleton EXTCODEHASH,
read from the Safe proxy's slot 0) when the matching --*-codehash flags are absent.
Replace every 0xFILL... placeholder before a production install.
Key consumption: preflight/verify --manifest reads singletonCodehash,
multiSendCodehash, safeMasterCopyCodehash, fallbackHandlerCodehash, and
fallbackHandlerAddress only; multiSendAddress and singletonAddress are
consumed by the lifecycle UI (address cross-checks), not by the scripts
(pass --multi-send explicitly to add the script-side address check).
gen-manifest-codehashes.sh does not emit fallbackHandlerCodehash or
safeMasterCopyCodehash; fill those with cast keccak "$(cast code <addr>)".

build._comment: Chain-invariant runtime EXTCODEHASH from this repo's build (solc 0.8.35, foundry.toml). Regenerate with scripts/gen-manifest-codehashes.sh.

_networkPolicy: The v1.0.0 launch target is Ethereum mainnet only. Future networks are added individually only after canonical Safe v1.5.0 + Transaction Service support and completed manifest/codehash/source/operator verification. The filled chains object is authoritative at release.
